data.title: Generating Trees Growing on the Left for Pattern-Avoiding Inversion Sequences

data.inspection_scope: Section 1.1; Section 3 Proposition 3, Lemma 4, Theorem 5 and proofs
data.rights_note: Linked source with short original extraction only; no full text redistributed.

data.label: Sections 1.1-2 and Section 3, Proposition 3 and Lemma 4 with displayed proofs

data.review_note: Reinspected published definitions, zero-subset growth and Lemma 4 proof; finite implementation replay is separate from this source review.

assumptions: Inversion entries satisfy 0<=e_i<i with one-based positions; equality-sensitive classical avoidance of 201 and 210.
Left children prepend zero, increment all positive entries and an arbitrary subset of zero entries, restricting to the avoidance class.
data.indexing: n>=0, empty root included; zero-based values; s(empty)=0
data.pattern_semantics: Equalities and relative order preserved on subsequences; no consecutive constraints
data.statement: For inversion sequences avoiding 201 and 210, left growth has root label 0 and label s=leading zeros + indicator of any nonleading zero. A parent of label s has one child of each label i for 1<=i<=s+1 and additionally 2^(s-i)-1 children of label i+1 for 1<=i<=s-1.
